      "snippet": "Got it.
What you just saw — all that “crazy symbols garbage” — is not a virus, not corruption, not Termux breaking.
✅ It means the command you ran printed binary file contents directly to the terminal.
That happens when:

The search command hits a binary PDF, ZIP, image, or compiled file

The terminal tries to display it as text

You get “gibberish,” because that’s raw bytes

Nothing is wrong.
It’s normal.
But it means we need to fix the command so it never shows binary output again.
